messages:
maria (eng-ml): Quick heads-up — shadow bring-up for awq-int8 on rift-70b shows odd hallucination spikes when prefix cache + continuous batching are on. Repro steps in a sec.
ashok (research): ugh, seen similar but assumed quant drift. Can you paste the exact config?
ben (infra): tagging infra — any increased QPS or concurrency during the runs?
maria (eng-ml): running a controlled batch: 1000 prompts, synthetic prefix distribution skewed (50% long prefixes). Config: `batching.coalesce_ms=12`, `continuous_batching=true`, `kv_cache.enabled=true`, `kv_cache.mode=prefix`, `quant.profile=awq-int8`.
olivia (mlops): deploy-bot triggered for a canary, saw the rollout: `deploy-bot: canary rift-70b-awq-int8 -> slot 3 (10%)` :rocket:
maria (eng-ml): log snippet when it spikes: ```WARN model.output_consistency: mismatched tokens at step 12, sample_id=482, prefix_key=f_3f2a... kv_hit=true```
ashok (research): interesting that kv_hit=true. That implies the cache returned something but output diverged. Maybe the quantized kv vectors are being used across different kernel runtimes?
ben (infra): the runtime route for canary uses mixed kernel selection: `fp8-path` fallback for some sequence lengths. Could be a kernel mismatch with latter layers — we have a bug where `kv_cache.key_hash` was computed before kernel-specific alignment.
maria (eng-ml): I flipped `continuous_batching=false` locally and the hallucination rate dropped ~4.2% -> 0.9%. So batching interplay seems causal.
olivia (mlops): any difference in latency/cost when disabling continuous batching? we need numbers to make rollout call.
maria (eng-ml): latency p50 went from 68ms -> 54ms disabled; cost per token up ~3% (expected). Tradeoff looks acceptable for the customer cohort.
ashok (research): hypothesis: continuous batching coalesces prefixes across requests causing KV cache to serve a value produced under a slightly different kernel/quant alignment. If prefix keys don't include kernel version, cache becomes incompatible.
ben (infra): confirmed — cache key currently: `sha1(model_id + prefix_hash)`. No kernel/quant tags. I'll PR to include `quant_tag` and `kernel_build_id` in cache key.
maria (eng-ml): can we also add a quick checksum in the cache value so we reject mismatched kernel reads? cheap guard.
ben (infra): yup, `value_meta.checksum` + `value_meta.quant_tag` added to plan. I'll open PR and stage to staging.
olivia (mlops): plan for canary rollback: hold canary at 0% and run A/B test on small segment with `continuous_batching=true` + new cache-key vs old for 10k inferences.
maria (eng-ml): also want to run FP8 vs AWQ vs GPTQ matrix with both cache-key variants — just to see if quant format correlates with error modes. I'll prepare eval harness.
ashok (research): add eval metrics: token-level divergence, lm-accuracy (QA sets), and hallucination FPR. Also capture `kv_hit_rate` and `cache_reject_rate` after checksum guard.
ben (infra): PR: https://git.redwood/infra/kv-cache-key-fix (draft). I'll add feature flag `kv_compat_checks=true` so we can toggle for canary.
olivia (mlops): scheduling the A/B run, will allocate GPU slots on dedicated pool d-2 for 3 hours tomorrow 01:00 UTC.
maria (eng-ml): thanks — will post results thread when matrix finishes. For now putting current canary on pause. :hand:
deploy-bot: Canary rift-70b-awq-int8 paused by olivia (mlops).
ashok (research): small note — if we add kernel id to key, we need to be careful during model rollouts where kernel evolves; consider a fallback policy: if key misses, compute on-demand but mark for later eviction rather than silently reading incompatible entry.
maria (eng-ml): agreed. eviction TTL + forced warmup policy. I'll include in the experiment doc.
olivia (mlops): created experiment doc: https://docs.redwood/experiments/quant-cache-shadow-compat (ops only). I'll invite you all.
ben (infra): thanks. moving to patch review.
maria (eng-ml): ordering next steps: 1) infra PR + flag 2) small A/B on d-2 3) full quant matrix 4) decide on permanent default.
ashok (research): sounds good. appreciate the rapid look.
maria (eng-ml): will post the eval summary in ~24h. TL;DR for now: disable continuous batching for global canary until we validate cache-key fix.
